subject.title: fix(sessions): keep Matrix DM session keys case-distinct per peer

question: Should this PR land now as a partial mitigation for Matrix `per-channel-peer` and `per-account-channel-peer`, while the canonical issue remains open for channel-agnostic `per-peer` and Signal direct identifiers?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound within its declared boundary, but deciding whether an incomplete mitigation is acceptable for a transcript-isolation issue requires explicit ownership of the remaining exposure and future migration direction.

options.title: Land scoped mitigation
options.body: Rebase and merge this proven reduction in exposure while retaining the canonical issue for `per-peer` and Signal follow-up.

options.title: Require complete coverage first
options.body: Hold the PR until a channel-aware persisted-key and migration design also resolves `per-peer` without changing case-insensitive channels incorrectly.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Leave the PR open but paused if maintainers do not want to extend the existing runtime folded-alias compatibility model.

recommendation.title: Land scoped mitigation
recommendation.body: Rebase and merge this proven reduction in exposure while retaining the canonical issue for `per-peer` and Signal follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the adjacent Signal opaque-ID change and merged the generic Matrix session-key preservation design being extended here.
